d: InnovationTeam is seeking a hands-on HR professional with comprehensive HR knowledge and capabilities expected of an HR Manager. Reporting to the current HR Manager, you will support approximately 400 employees, with planned hiring of more than 100 additional employees and further growth expected across our IT services and project-based business.
q: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
At least two years of experience in an HR management role or as a Senior HR Specialist, with practical exposure across core HR functions.
Experience in IT, technology services, systems integration, or project-based organizations is preferred.
Experience supporting a workforce of several hundred employees is preferred.
Sound knowledge of Saudi labor regulations, Saudization, relevant government platforms, and HR management systems.
Ability to analyze workforce data and costs and provide clear, practical recommendations.
Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills, with a hands-on approach and effective coordination across divisions.
High standards of confidentiality, professional judgment, and integrity.
Proficiency in spoken and written English.
Relevant professional HR certifications are preferred.

Every gesture, every smile, every action, contributes to creating a positive and memorable impact for our customers, our colleagues and also for our planet. Together, we embody the vision of responsible hospitality.
Take the opportunity to become a Heartist®, and let your heart guide you in this world where life beats faster.
Perform preventive and corrective maintenance of electrical systems, equipment, and fixtures within the hotel.
Troubleshoot and repair electrical faults, lighting systems, power outlets, motors, and control panels.
Conduct regular inspections to identify and resolve potential electrical issues.
Respond promptly to maintenance requests and emergency breakdowns.
Ensure all work is carried out in compliance with safety regulations and hotel standards.
Maintain records of repairs, maintenance activities, and equipment performance.
Assist with installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical equipment when required.
Coordinate with other engineering team members to ensure smooth hotel operations.
q: Previous experience preferably in a hotel, commercial building, or facility management environment.
Knowledge of HVAC, BMS, or other building systems, wiring, lighting, motors, generators, and preventive maintenance practices.is an advantage.
Good communication skills and ability to work effectively within a team.

d: Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

We are seeking an experienced and collaborative Manager, People Operations to lead the People function in Qatar. This role combines strategic partnership with operational leadership, ensuring our people, leaders and businesses have the support, capability and environment needed to achieve their goals. You'll play a key role in shaping culture, driving organisational effectiveness, building leadership capability and creating an exceptional employee experience.

Lead the end-to-end delivery of People Operations activities across Qatar, ensuring high-quality, compliant and commercially focused HR services that support business performance and project delivery.

Partner with business leaders to understand workforce priorities, organisational challenges and future capability requirements, developing practical people solutions that support business growth and operational effectiveness.
Drive the execution of Worley's people strategy within Qatar, ensuring alignment between local business needs, regional priorities and enterprise-wide people initiatives.

Act as a trusted advisor and coach to leaders on organisational effectiveness, workforce planning, leadership capability, employee relations, performance management, succession planning and change management.
Lead local people initiatives and projects that enhance employee experience, strengthen organisational capability, improve workforce effectiveness and support sustainable business growth.

Collaborate with COEs including Talent Acquisition, Reward, Talent Management, Mobility and remuneration and benefits and digital execution to deliver integrated people solutions and ensure successful implementation of enterprise programmes within the business.
Oversee employee relations matters, workplace accountability processes and people risk management activities, ensuring fair, consistent and legally compliant outcomes.
Lead workforce planning and talent discussions, ensuring the business has the capability, succession pipelines and talent strategies required to meet current and future operational demands.
Champion employee engagement, inclusion, wellbeing, culture and retention initiatives that strengthen Worley's Employee Value Proposition and support a high-performing workplace.
Oversee local compliance requirements, including employment legislation, visas, immigration, professional registrations, business licensing obligations and associated governance requirements.
Use workforce insights, people data and business trends to identify risks and opportunities, influencing decision-making and supporting the achievement of business objectives.
Partner with Shared Services and COEs to continuously improve processes, service delivery and employee experience while ensuring effective governance and operational efficiency.
Lead and support organisational change initiatives, ensuring effective stakeholder engagement, communication, readiness and adoption.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement, ensuring that Worley's values are embedded in everyday leadership and people practices.
q: We're looking for an experienced People leader who combines strong HR operational expertise, strategic business partnering capability and a demonstrated ability to deliver people outcomes in a complex, fast-paced environment. You will be comfortable balancing hands-on operational delivery with longer-term workforce planning, organisational effectiveness and people initiatives that support business growth.
Chartered CIPD qualification or equivalent professional HR accreditation.
Experience supporting large-scale projects, engineering, energy, chemicals or resources sector businesses.
Experience leading organisation design, restructuring, workforce transformation or culture change programmes.

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

d: Would you like to be part of the most international company in the world? A company operating in more than 220 countries worldwide and has been pioneering cross-border express shipping since 1969. Would you like to be part of a business that connects people across the globe and want to make a difference? Then waste no time and join our amazing team at DHL Group. DHL Global Forwarding, Freight (DGFF) is the Group's air, ocean, and road freight specialist. We offer standardized transport as well as highly specialized end-to-end solutions to customers in a wide range of industries globally.
Who ever said ‘‘the sky is the limit’’ never spoke to you! Because for you it’s the beginning DHL Global Forwarding has an opening for Manager Warehouse & Manual Handling in Manama, Bahrain.
Join us in connecting people and improving lives!
In this Manager Warehouse & Manual Handling position
Plan, manage, and monitor daily inbound, receiving, put-away, storage, replenishment, picking, packing, value-added services, staging, and outbound activities.
Ensure operations are completed safely, accurately, and on time in line with customer contracts, SOPs, service-level agreements, and agreed cost targets.
Allocate labor, equipment, storage space, and shift coverage according to workload, priorities, productivity standards, and capacity constraints.
Maintain effective inventory control through cycle counts, stock reconciliation, location audits, traceability controls, and disciplined stock-adjustment processes.
Investigate stock variances, damages, shortages, wrong picks, delays, and process failures, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Control warehouse operating costs, labor productivity, overtime, equipment utilization, consumables, maintenance, subcontractors, and revenue leakage.
Monitor operational and customer KPIs, lead performance reviews, resolve escalations, and maintain accurate daily, weekly, and monthly reporting.
Drive continuous improvement, standardization, waste reduction, service enhancement, and operational profitability.
Lead supervisors, coordinators, inventory personnel, warehouse assistants, and outsourced labor, with clear objectives, coaching, performance management, training, and succession planning.
Manage operational disruptions and maintain effective business-continuity arrangements.
Lead the design, setup, implementation, commissioning, and launch of new warehouse operations.
Lead warehouse expansion, relocation, redesign, and capacity-enhancement projects while protecting service continuity.
Translate business and customer requirements into practical warehouse operating solutions and implementation plans.
Develop capacity models covering storage positions, throughput, labor, equipment, docks, staging, utilities, and future growth.
Design, validate, and optimize warehouse layouts, product flows, operational zones, storage locations, pedestrian routes, and vehicle movements.
Define storage-media and racking requirements and lead specification, procurement, installation, inspection, and operational acceptance.
Evaluate, select, deploy, and commission material-handling equipment based on safety, productivity, service, and lifecycle-cost requirements.
Provide operational input into facility design, security, fire protection, utilities, maintenance access, and future expansion requirements.

Lead the operational workstream for WMS implementation and optimization, including requirements definition, configuration validation, master-data readiness, integration, testing, user acceptance, training, cutover, and stabilization.
Ensure warehouse transactions, inventory records, interfaces, and reporting are accurate, timely, controlled, and auditable.
Assess and deploy barcode, scanning, labeling, mobility, automation, and related warehouse technologies.
Coordinate with IT, customers, vendors, and operations teams to resolve system issues and deliver enhancements without compromising service or inventory integrity.
Develop, approve, implement, and maintain SOPs, work instructions, process maps, control plans, escalation procedures, and operational records for new and existing operations.
Design inventory-control frameworks covering receiving, put-away, storage, replenishment, picking, dispatch, cycle counting, reconciliation, and stock adjustments.
Establish KPI, reporting, review, escalation, and operational-governance frameworks aligned with contractual SLAs and business objectives.
Develop and test business-continuity, emergency-response, disruption-management, and recovery plans.
Use root-cause analysis and structured improvement methods to reduce errors, waste, damage, delays, risk, and cost.
Health, Safety, Security, Quality and Compliance
Provide visible safety leadership and ensure full compliance with DHL HSSEQ requirements, Bahrain laws, customer standards, site rules, and applicable regulatory approvals.
Lead workplace inspections, risk assessments, toolbox talks, incident investigations, corrective actions, and operational safety reviews.
Maintain safe systems of work for MHE, racking, loading areas, batteries, dangerous goods, temperature-controlled products, contractors, and other special operations where applicable.

Ensure new and expanded operations meet fire and civil-defence requirements, relevant ISO and quality standards, security controls, insurance conditions, and customer compliance requirements before launch.
Maintain audit readiness and lead internal, customer, regulatory, and certification audit actions.
Develop and test emergency-response plans and ensure employees and contractors are trained for relevant scenarios.
Lead end-to-end customer onboarding and implementation projects from operational solution validation and planning through go-live and stabilization.
Partner with Sales, Solutions, Finance, IT, Procurement, HSE, and customers to validate operating models, resource assumptions, implementation costs, SLAs, controls, and operational feasibility.
Develop implementation plans, milestones, budgets, risk registers, readiness criteria, governance routines, and stakeholder reporting.
Manage customer transition, data and inventory migration, operational trials, issue resolution, and formal handover into business-as-usual operations.
Act as the primary operational contact for assigned customers, review service performance, resolve concerns, and maintain clear action plans.
Ensure activities outside agreed scope are identified, approved, documented, and communicated for billing.
Coordinate cross-functional teams involving Operations, Sales, Finance, Procurement, IT, HSE, HR, Facilities, Engineering, and other support functions.
Coordinate customers, contractors, equipment providers, system vendors, suppliers, and regulatory stakeholders to deliver implementation and operational outcomes.
Define clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, escalation routes, and acceptance criteria across all project workstreams.
Maintain transparent project governance and escalate material scope, timeline, cost, capacity, safety, quality, or customer risks promptly.
Design the organization structure, staffing model, shift pattern, workforce plan, resource forecast, and competency framework for new and expanded operations.
Develop recruitment, mobilization, induction, systems training, operational certification, and succession plans.
Set clear objectives, assign responsibilities, monitor performance, and provide regular coaching and feedback.
Ensure employees and outsourced personnel are trained, competent, engaged, and compliant with company policies and site requirements.
Promote teamwork, accountability, discipline, inclusion, and continuous development.
Lead warehouse commissioning, readiness reviews, operational testing, pre-go-live simulations, defect closure, and formal operational acceptance.
Own go-live planning, cutover execution, command-centre governance, performance monitoring, and rapid issue resolution.
Lead post-launch stabilization until agreed service, safety, inventory, productivity, cost, and control standards are consistently achieved.
Complete formal handover into business-as-usual operations while retaining long-term accountability for warehouse performance.
Own the warehouse P&L and deliver the approved budget, including achievement of the agreed EBIT target.
Manage warehouse operating budgets and implementation costs, including labor, overtime, equipment, consumables, maintenance, subcontractors, and project expenditure.
Support annual budgets, forecasts, business cases, CAPEX submissions, and resource-planning processes.
Monitor productivity, utilization, cost per activity, revenue leakage, billing accuracy, and operational profitability.
